notes.title: Hackhub Devblog #4
notes.content: [quote][p][b]Note: This update is still in development and hasn’t been released yet. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in HackHub![/b] 🛠️[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]Hello Hackers! 🚀[/h2][p]DevBlog 4 is packed with new features, mission content, tool improvements, and system updates. Here’s what’s coming next:[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][list][*][p]In-game [b]git[/b] support: clone and pull commands added — you can now clone player repositories and update them with pull.[/p][/*][*][p]systemctl system added: set system config vars and restart services (requires root).[/p][/*][*][p]New quest lines: [b]Database Theft[/b] & [b]Competitor Sabotage[/b] added.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes & Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Settings → Wallpapers[/b]: Fixed overflow showing in the Wallpapers section — no more visual overflow/scroll bug.[/p][/*][*][p][b]sqlmap[/b]: Added help parameter (-h for help).[/p][/*][*][p][b]John[/b] tool: John no longer decrypts the entire passwd file — it now only decrypts password hashes. Hint text updated accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]HackHub server optimizations and updates.[/p][/*][*][p]In-game Git system: added support for clone and pull.[/p][/*][*][p]Terminal error output minimized.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to println method in the terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]mxlookup command improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Subnet encryption system changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Subnet root passwords are now stored in the system, but they will still [b]not[/b] appear in /etc/passwd.[/p][/*][*][p]rootgrab command added to Metasploit — usable only when you have a meterpreter session.[/p][list][*][p]You can use the Metasploit rootgrab tool to attempt to access a system’s root password.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]systemctl commands:[/p][list][*][p]systemctl config <key> <value> — set a system config variable (only existing config keys can be changed; requires root).[/p][/*][*][p]systemctl restart — restart a system’s services (requires root).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New missions: [b]Database Theft[/b] & [b]Competitor Sabotage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Firebear browser: fixed bug related to closing tabs.[/p][/*][*][p]Kisscord: adding friends via Enter key.[/p][/*][*][p]Lynx: search now supports case-insensitive search — you no longer need exact case matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Surfaces system: if an app is open and its maxOpen value is 1, attempting to open it again will focus the existing instance instead of opening another.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an objective ordering bug in the [b]Altering Exam Grades[/b] quest.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hackhub Devblog 3
notes.content: [p][/p][quote][p]🛠️ [b]Note:[/b] This update is still in development and hasn’t been released yet. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in HackHub! 🚧[/p][/quote][p][/p][h1]Hello Hackers! 🚀[/h1][p]DevBlog 3 is here with a fresh round of improvements and fixes. This update focuses on making networks more realistic, terminal usage smoother, and gameplay interactions more dynamic. [/p][p]Here’s what’s on the way:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Terminal Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed input and prompt alignment issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Commands and cursor now line up properly, making typing smoother.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Wi-Fi System Overhaul[/b][/p][list][*][p]Wi-Fi networks are now fully integrated into the subnet and port system.[/p][/*][*][p]Model numbers are randomized — sometimes hidden for extra mystery.[/p][/*][*][p]Added randomized phishing opportunities: in certain cases, providers can be targeted via email.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tool Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a major Wireshark bug where packet transfers weren’t displaying correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Localization Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some translation errors have been corrected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: HackHub DevBlog 2 – Upcoming Updates & Improvements
notes.content: [quote][p][b]Note:[/b] This update is still in development and hasn’t been released yet. Here’s a sneak peek at what’s coming in HackHub! 🚧[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Hello Hackers! 🚀[/p][p]DevBlog 2 is here to give you a look at the upcoming changes and improvements in HackHub. This update aims to make your experience more realistic, faster, and user-friendly. Here’s what’s planned:[/p][p][/p][h2]🌙 Dark Mode[/h2][list][*][p]Dark mode will be added to all Goagle websites (Homepage, Search, Mail).[/p][/*][*][p]Perfect for long sessions without straining your eyes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🖥 Desktop & File System Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Desktop icon placement issues will be fixed and icon styles slightly updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug when creating a file with the same name will be fixed. Now, files will behave like a real OS: duplicate names will be automatically numbered (e.g., file (2)).[/p][/*][/list][h2]💻 Terminal Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Terminal structure is being updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Table layouts in the terminal will now fit correctly on the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll will automatically follow new lines, solving previous issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Unnecessary empty space at the bottom of the terminal will be removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Terminal alignment problems will be fixed.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🌐 Firebear Browser v2[/h2][list][*][p]Fully rebuilt with a modern and faster interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Designed to behave like a real web browser, supporting IP addresses and ports directly from the terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]System notifications inside the Surfaces system will automatically open URLs in the browser when clicked.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012800/6d2a4ddea1d4783366974f5b5d0488c0be945ed3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012800/781ccf0770aca7531b47f2145cb58f0c463bedfa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012800/56fae17a600fd1af54bdc20f87c763f147e2e6da.png"][/img][/p][h2]✉️ Typewriter System[/h2][list][*][p]The typewriter system (Kisscord messages, mails) will now have a [b]“Character”[/b] mode option.[/p][/*][*][p]Instead of sending single characters per keystroke, it will type one word per key press.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings: Settings → Gameplay → Typewriter Mode.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🛠 Miscellaneous Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Translation issues are being corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Desktop overlapping icon problems will be fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Kisscord chat will automatically focus input when switching chat screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Various other bug fixes and performance improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hackhub Devblog – Major Update 🚀
notes.content:
[p]🛠️ [b]Note:[/b] This devblog showcases features that are still in development. They are not live yet, but will be part of upcoming updatesd.[/p][p][/p][p]Hello Hackers,[/p][p]We’ve been working hard on Hackhub and we’re excited to share the latest progress with you. This update brings massive improvements to performance, stability, and gameplay depth. Let’s dive into what’s new:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Bug Fixes & Core Systems[/h3][list][*][p]Old [b]programs system[/b] has been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]A brand new, [b]high-performance Surfaces system[/b] has been implemented. All programs now run on this new system for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Terminal commands have been refactored[/b] for better reliability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Node command & in-game scripting[/b] got major improvements, making scripting more stable and powerful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Python3 command updated[/b], with reworked scripts and brand new Python scripts added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New terminal commands[/b] have been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grep command[/b] has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dig command[/b] has been added.[/p][/*][*][p][b]MXLookup command added[/b] → DNS lookup queries can now be performed.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌐 Tools & Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Metasploit has been reworked[/b] with several improvements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Web browser system redesigned[/b] for a better user experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New websites[/b] have been added to explore, including a [b]GitHub website[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pip package manager[/b] is now available for script management.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NTLM systems and hacking methods[/b] have been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wireshark added[/b] → monitor data sharing between IPs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]System configs[/b] added → devices now behave according to their configuration settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Subfinder added[/b] → discover subdomains for pentesting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nuclei added[/b] → vulnerability scanning for pentesting.
[i](These tools are implemented similarly to their real-life pentesting counterparts.)[/i][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🖥️ Terminal Upgrades[/h3][p]You can now [b]stop running commands[/b] in the terminal with Ctrl + C.[/p][list][*][p]If text is selected → it copies to clipboard.[/p][/*][*][p]If no text is selected → it cancels the currently running process (for example, an unfinished lynx query).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Missions & Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p][b]The Journalist Sister mission series has been added.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New [b]side missions[/b] have been added to expand your hacking journey.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚡ Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Optimized [b]game loading system[/b] – some packages are now preloaded during the loading screen for faster runtime performance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌍 Multiplayer Foundations[/h3][list][*][p]The very first steps of [b]multiplayer[/b] have been implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]Currently, only a [b]European server[/b] is live.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Account Center system[/b] has been introduced.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📂 Git System in Hackhub[/h3][list][*][p]A full [b]Git system[/b] has been added![/p][/*][*][p]Share your scripts with other players using real Git commands:[/p][/*][*][p]git init, git commit, git push, git clone, git pull[/p][/*][*][p]Keep your repos [b]public[/b] to share, or [b]private[/b] to store your scripts securely.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌐 Networking Systems[/h3][list][*][p][b]Network system designed from scratch[/b] – every IP address now represents a real device connected to a network.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wireshark monitoring[/b] → inspect data sharing between IPs in real time.[/p][/*][*][p][b]System configs[/b] → devices now behave according to their configuration settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Modem interface system[/b] added:[/p][list][*][p]View existing ports.[/p][/*][*][p]Configure [b]port forwarding[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Firewall system[/b] implemented:[/p][list][*][p]Add or remove rules.[/p][/*][*][p]Even if a port is open, connections will fail if blocked by firewall rules.[/p][/*][*][p]To gain access, you’ll also need to hack into and modify firewall settings.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 UI/UX Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Main menu layout redesigned[/b] for a cleaner look.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]stats panel in the main menu[/b] so you can easily track your progress in the game.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]This update lays down the foundation for the future of Hackhub. Multiplayer and online systems are just getting started, and the new networking layer brings a whole new level of realism. We can’t wait to see how you’ll explore, exploit, and secure these systems.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - Hotfix[/b]

We've released a small hotfix addressing the following issues:

• 🌐 [b]Handbook Crash Fix[/b]  
Fixed a bug causing the game to crash when opening the handbook in certain languages.

• 🕵️ [b]Steal Exam Questions Quest Fix[/b]  
Resolved an issue where the “Search” objective in the "Steal Exam Questions" mission would not register as complete under certain conditions.

Thank you for reporting these issues — we're continuing to monitor feedback and improve stability!
